app.name: DisputeOS
app.tagline: Credit repair that tracks results, not volume.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.mfaRequired: Multi-factor authentication is required for staff accounts.

reports.title: Report review
reports.subtitle: Paste report text. Each extracted value is shown next to its source line; low-confidence fields are highlighted for you to confirm.
reports.pageNote: Demo screen: nothing is saved. Full account numbers are never displayed.

compliance.disclaimer: DisputeOS is software, not legal advice. No one can guarantee removal of accurate information or a specific score outcome.

home.headline: Dispute smarter. Track every result.
home.sub: Import your reports, see exactly what's wrong, approve personalized letters, and watch results come in.

analysis.title: Findings & letters
analysis.subtitle: Ranked by strength of basis. Every letter is built from your own report facts and vetted citations. You approve before anything is mailed.
analysis.noPromise: Estimates and findings are not guarantees. Only dispute information you believe is inaccurate.

mail.title: Mail queue
mail.subtitle: Letters are only mailed after a person approves them. Each send is idempotent and tracked.

clients.title: Import clients
clients.subtitle: Paste a CSV exported from Credit Repair Cloud, DisputeFox or a spreadsheet. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
clients.name: Name
clients.note: Phone numbers are masked on screen. Pulling credit reports requires documented client consent.
clients.inviteSub: Generate a secure link (valid 14 days) to text or email. Clients enter their own info and consent.

join.welcomeBody: Your credit specialist invited you to securely share a few details. It takes about two minutes.
join.step2: Review and agree to the disclosures
join.step3: Your specialist reviews your credit reports with you
join.secure: Encrypted in transit. Your information is only shared with your credit specialist.
join.formSub: We use this to prepare your file. You can change it later.
join.name: Full legal name
join.consentCroa: I have read the Consumer Credit File Rights disclosure and understand I may cancel within 3 business days.
join.consentReports: I authorize my credit specialist to obtain and review my credit reports to identify inaccurate information.
join.doneBody: Your specialist has what they need and will be in touch shortly.
join.preview: Preview mode: this submission was validated but not stored.
join.errConsent: Both agreements are required to continue.
join.errInvite: This link is not valid. Please ask for a new one.
join.errStorage: We couldn't save your information right now. Please try again later.
join.expiredBody: Please ask your credit specialist to send you a new sign-up link.
join.disclaimer: Results are not guaranteed. Credit repair services cannot remove accurate, timely, verifiable information.
